description_en: Retrieves a list of Public DNS threat logs
description_zh: 获取公共DNS 威胁日志列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-pdns-threat-logs --lang example-string --threat-type example-string --threat-level example-string --threat-source-ip example-string --keyword example-string --start-date example-string --end-date example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePdnsThreatLogs

parameters.help_en: Specifies the language for the request and response. Valid values: zh for Chinese and en for English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；默认为 zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by threat type
parameters.name: threat_type

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by threat level
parameters.name: threat_level

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by the source IP address of the threat request
parameters.help_zh: 按威胁请求的源 IP 筛选
parameters.name: threat_source_ip

parameters.help_en: Specifies the keyword used to query the threat log content
parameters.help_zh: 按威胁日志内容查询的关键词
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: Specifies the start date of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: Specifies the end date of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page in a paging query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页返回的记录数
parameters.name: page_size

Logs.description_en: The list of Public DNS threat logs
Logs.description_zh: 公共 DNS 威胁日志列表

items.description_en: The details of a Public DNS threat log
items.description_zh: 单条公共 DNS 威胁日志

SourceIp.description_en: The source IP address that initiated the threat request
SourceIp.description_zh: 产生威胁请求的源 IP 地址

ThreatTime.description_en: The time when the threat request occurred. The time is displayed in UTC+8. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
ThreatTime.description_zh: 威胁请求发生时间，北京时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned result

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果每页的记录数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数
